title: Mr Brandes
html_source: Georg Brandes (1842-1927), born Morris Cohen, Of Jewish descent, was a Danish writer & critic. His realistic principles were shared with Henrik Ibsen, who was admired by Joyce. His “Critical Study” of Shakespeare was highly regarded.
